annotation.title_clean: Policy for the Development of Artificial Intelligence in Poland from 2020
annotation.title_en: Policy for the Development of Artificial Intelligence in Poland from 2020
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Council of Ministers of the Republic of Poland (Ministry of Digital Affairs / Chancellery of the Prime Minister)
annotation.venue: Monitor Polski (Resolution no. 196 of the Council of Ministers, 28 December 2020)
named_instruments_referenced: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI
annotation.summary_en: Poland's 2020 national AI strategy sets short-, medium- and long-term objectives across six areas: society, companies, science, education, international cooperation and the public sector. It is innovation-oriented and aligned with EU trustworthy-AI and OECD principles. Embodied AI appears only in passing: autonomous vehicle testing zones, agricultural drones, robotics and labour effects.
key_provisions_or_claims: Six-area strategy with objectives to 2023, 2027 and beyond, coordinated by the minister for computerisation and an AI Policy Task Force
Mandatory ex-ante self-assessment, explanation and appeal rights for AI used in public administration decisions
Test autonomous ground, water and air vehicles in designated zones to determine liability limits for developers, makers and operators
Update the legal framework for autonomous AI drones in agriculture
Counteract granting legal personality to AI; liability based on diligence for developers and risk for operators
